message.content: On September 16, 2026, LiHua expressed enthusiasm for the idea of incorporating improvisational solos into their practice sessions, describing it as a "great idea" that would make their sessions more "fun and creative." Additionally, LiHua highlighted the potential benefits of improvisation, stating that it would "definitely make our sessions more fun and creative" and help them "grow as musicians."
